steps.en: Install PyTorch and torchao yourself, then the library
steps.zh: 先自己装 PyTorch 和 torchao，再装这个库
steps.code: pip install torch torchvision torchao · pip install torchtune

steps.en: Download the base model's weights from the Hugging Face Hub
steps.zh: 从 Hugging Face Hub 下载基座模型权重

steps.en: Ships a ready YAML config per model, size and method
steps.zh: 按模型、尺寸和方法备好现成的 YAML 配置

steps.en: Run a recipe with a config, overriding fields on the command line
steps.zh: 用某份配置运行配方，在命令行覆盖字段

steps.en: Builds model, tokenizer and dataset from the config in plain PyTorch
steps.zh: 按配置用纯 PyTorch 搭好模型、分词器和数据集

steps.en: Runs the training loop with the memory switches you set and saves checkpoints
steps.zh: 按你打开的省显存开关跑训练循环，并保存 checkpoint

value.en: A LoRA or full fine-tune from one command, with every line of the training loop readable PyTorch
value.zh: 一条命令跑起 LoRA 或全量微调，训练循环每一行都是看得懂的 PyTorch

sources: README.md @ 2026-10-08 'Install stable release': 'pip install torch torchvision torchao', 'pip install torchtune'
README.md @ 2026-10-08 'Running finetuning recipes': 'tune run lora_finetune_single_device --config llama3_1/8B_lora_single_device'; 'Modify Configs': config overrides on the command line, 'tune cp'
README.md @ 2026-10-08 'Overview' and 'Optimization flags': hackable recipes, YAML configs, plain PyTorch model implementations, activation checkpointing/offloading toggled in config
